description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Name, which extends HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule and configures certain HTML elements ('a', 'applet', 'form', 'frame', 'iframe', 'img', 'map') by adding attribute handling related to 'name'. It is part of the HTML purification process, specifically related to handling 'name' attributes in elements.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Name
classes.description: A module that configures 'name'-related attributes for certain HTML elements during the purification process.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the module by adding specific HTML elements and configuring their 'name' attributes, and conditionally adding attribute transformations based on configuration.
